work.description: Brief CIX grants the Feltre cathedral canons violet dress and the first dignity the bugia; LF20786 → LF20801 across a rule mark LF20789, own provenance LF20792, page number LF20795 and page-141 running title LF20798; complete 19 August 1836 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF20770–20770; the source closing at LF20855–20858 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona augusti mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontifi- catus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
